_schema.active: boolean — false when no task is active
_schema.goal: string — the user's request, expanded per AGENTS.md §2
_schema.status: none | planning | in_progress | paused | review | complete | merged
_schema.branch: codex/<slug> while a unit is in progress; null between units (completed units are merged and their branches deleted)

pr.state: open | null — the in-progress unit's PR; merged PRs are listed in merged_prs

<unit id>.title: topic page name
<unit id>.diagnosis: one line, improve mode: what was wrong
<unit id>.commit: SHA of the commit that completed the unit, or null

_schema.next_action: one imperative sentence a fresh run can execute without any other context
_schema.last_commit: SHA of the last commit made by this task
_schema.ready_to_merge: boolean — true when the task is complete and the final cross-topic check is on main (under auto policy every unit is already merged)
_schema.merge_policy: auto | hold | direct — auto (default) merges every completed unit into main immediately; hold keeps one open PR for the task; direct pushes completed units to main without PRs

next_action: Wait for a user prompt; on a task prompt run workflow.md Phase 0 and Phase 1.
